title: Delinking Childcare Subsidies from Mother's Employment Status
what_it_is: Delinking Childcare Subsidies from Mother's Employment Status

sections.label: Childcare subsidies and working mothers
sections.summary: The Government gives working mothers higher childcare subsidies, with flexibility for those unable to work, and KiFAS does not depend on working status.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: As working mothers need childcare while they are at work, the Government provides them with higher basic subsidies, as well as means-tested additional subsidies, if eligible.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The mother's working status is thus a criterion for higher subsidies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Notwithstanding this, the Government does exercise flexibility where the mother is unable to work and yet requires childcare services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: ECDA is planning to provide better subsidy support, especially for low-income families and will announce details at MSF's Committee of Supply.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Non-working mothers who do not require full-day childcare can enrol their children in half-day kindergartens, which are shorter and often more affordable than full-day childcare programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: There is, of course, KiFAS, which does not depend on working mother status.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Families with children enrolled in kindergartens run by Anchor Operators and MOE may be eligible for means-tested kindergarten subsidies – as I said, KiFAS – which do not depend on the mother’s working status.

sections.label: Subsidy for working mothers
sections.summary: The subsidy was intended to support mothers who go to work.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
